scenes.name: TWO DIVISORS
lines: Column three begins with fourteen, twenty-nine, and fifty. All leave remainder two when divided by three.
第 3 列从 14、29、50 开始。它们除以 3 都余 2。
But try dividing by two instead: the middle number fails. What changed?
但改为除以 2，中间的数就不能整除。哪里变了？

scenes.name: THE LAST TERM
lines: Each entry is a sum. In column three its three pieces are three times n times n plus one, nine n, and fourteen.
每个表项都是一个和。第 3 列的三项依次为 3n(n+1)、9n、14。
Modulo three, the first two pieces vanish. The last piece is fourteen, independent of the row.
模 3 时前两项消失。最后一项是 14，与行号无关。
In any column, every earlier term keeps the column number as a factor in its factorial.
任意一列中，较早各项的阶乘都保留着列号这个因子。

scenes.name: THE NEXT-TO-LAST TERM
lines: Modulo two, the first and last pieces vanish instead. The middle piece, nine n, has the same parity as n.
模 2 时，第一项和末项消失。中间一项 9n 的奇偶与 n 相同。
For a prime column, this row-dependent term can obstruct division by one less than the prime only at three and five.
在质数列中，这个随行变化的项只在质数 3 和 5 时可能妨碍除以质数减一。
At seven and above the remaining factorial already contains enough factors. At two the divisor is just one.
从 7 开始，留下的阶乘已经有足够的因子；在 2 时除数只是 1。

scenes.name: THE PAYOFF
lines: Odd rows fail at three and five, but work at all other primes. Every integral quotient leaves remainder one modulo its prime.
奇数行在 3 和 5 处失败，在其他质数列则成功。每个整数商除以对应质数都余 1。
The same sum also explains why the column is a polynomial in the row number.
同一个和式还解释了为什么每一列都是行号的多项式。
